boards.title: Your First Weekend at University of Missouri-Kansas City, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure first-weekend sequence that starts on the Volker Campus and opens into nearby Kansas City art, gardens, and public spaces.

cards.title: Start with a game at the Student Union
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · UMKC Student Union, Level 2
cards.notes: Bring your UMKC ID to the Welcome Desk, check out pool or table-tennis equipment, and use a game to make an easy first introduction.
cards.short_summary: A campus-based icebreaker with equipment checkout handled at the Welcome Desk.
cards.evidence_claim: UMKC says billiards tables and table tennis are on Level 2 by Starbucks, and students may use billiards free during operating hours with a UMKC ID.
cards.access_notes: Show a UMKC ID at the Welcome Desk to check out equipment; use is during Student Union operating hours.

cards.title: Make dinner plans at Foodiverse
cards.subtitle: Friday early evening · UMKC Student Union
cards.notes: Walk the Foodiverse counters together and choose a meal that fits your appetite; use this stop to keep the first evening on campus.
cards.short_summary: A multi-counter dining stop inside the Student Union.
cards.evidence_claim: UMKC lists Student Union Foodiverse dining options including Simple Servings, Cherry St. Deli, Joey's Pizza & Pasta, Fresh Harvest, Union Grill Co. and 7 Spoons.
cards.access_notes: Food service is located in the UMKC Student Union; check the dining service for current operating details.

cards.title: Settle in at Miller Nichols Library
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · 800 E. 51st St.
cards.notes: Choose an individual or group study area, connect to the library Wi-Fi, and make a short plan for the first week before heading out.
cards.short_summary: UMKC's largest library offers study seating and campus collections.
cards.evidence_claim: Miller Nichols Library is UMKC's largest library and provides Wi-Fi plus seating for individual and group study.
cards.access_notes: The library lists daily hours separately; consult its current hours before visiting.

cards.title: See what is on view at UMKC Gallery of Art
cards.subtitle: Friday daytime · Fine Arts Building, Room 203
cards.notes: Stop by during gallery hours, take in the current work, and check the exhibition information for an artist or idea worth discussing afterward.
cards.short_summary: A public campus exhibition space for guest and student artists.
cards.evidence_claim: UMKC describes the UMKC Gallery of Art as a public exhibition space featuring guest and student artists, open during regular gallery hours or by appointment.
cards.access_notes: The gallery lists Monday-Friday hours and is closed Saturdays and Sundays except by appointment.

cards.title: Move around at Swinney Center
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · 5030 Holmes St.
cards.notes: Use the fitness center, track, courts, or pool as your schedule and recreation access allow, then borrow any needed equipment at the service center.
cards.short_summary: Campus recreation facilities provide several indoor ways to reset on a weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: UMKC lists a fitness center, multipurpose courts, indoor track, 25-yard lap pool, studios, sauna and equipment checkout at Swinney Center.
cards.access_notes: Listed weekend hours are Saturday 9 a.m.-6 p.m. and Sunday noon-6 p.m.; recreation membership or an applicable day pass is required.

cards.entity_name: Ewing and Muriel Kauffman Memorial Garden
cards.title: Walk the Kauffman Memorial Garden
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · 4801 Rockhill Road
cards.notes: Follow the brick walkways at an unhurried pace, notice the changing plantings and bronze sculptures, and respect the garden's no-alcohol policy.
cards.short_summary: A public garden with seasonal displays, fountains, and sculpture near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kauffman Memorial Garden welcomes all ages and states that admission and parking are free; it features seasonal plantings, fountains and bronze sculptures.
cards.source_title: Ewing and Muriel Kauffman Memorial Garden
cards.access_notes: All ages are welcome. The garden prohibits alcoholic drinks, biking, and rollerblading.

cards.title: Explore the Nelson-Atkins galleries
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · 4525 Oak St.
cards.notes: Check in at an entrance, pick a gallery wing or collection to explore, and leave time to walk outside among the sculpture park installations.
cards.short_summary: A nearby art museum where general-admission galleries are available without an admission charge.
cards.evidence_claim: The Nelson-Atkins states that admission is free every day for everyone, with check-in required for access to general-admission galleries.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit to The Nelson-Atkins Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Check in online or at the museum before entering galleries; museum hours vary by day.

cards.entity_name: Laura Conyers Smith Municipal Rose Garden
cards.title: Take a Loose Park garden loop
cards.subtitle: Saturday late afternoon · Loose Park
cards.notes: Walk to the municipal rose garden, take in the planted beds and fountains, and keep food and picnics outside the rose-garden area.
cards.short_summary: A named garden within Loose Park with thousands of roses and historic roots.
cards.evidence_claim: Kansas City Parks identifies the Laura Conyers Smith Municipal Rose Garden as a Loose Park amenity and says it contains about 3,000 roses in nearly 130 varieties.
cards.access_notes: Loose Park lists hours of 5 a.m.-midnight daily; no food or picnics are allowed in the Rose Garden.

cards.title: Ride the KC Streetcar to see the corridor
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · UMKC to River Market route
cards.notes: Board at a marked stop, use the ride to orient yourself along Main Street, and check the live service information before planning a return trip.
cards.short_summary: A fare-free streetcar route connecting UMKC with destinations north along Main Street.
cards.evidence_claim: KC Streetcar states that there is no fare to ride from UMKC to the River Market and lists Friday and Saturday service until 1 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Listed Friday and Saturday service runs 5 a.m.-1 a.m.; verify service alerts before travel.

cards.entity_name: Kansas City Public Library Plaza Branch
cards.title: Wrap up at Plaza Branch
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · 4801 Main St.
cards.notes: Find a window seat or study pod, browse the arts resources, and pause by the Good As Gold book sculpture before heading back toward campus.
cards.short_summary: A public library branch near the Plaza with study resources, events, and a book-based sculpture.
cards.evidence_claim: The Plaza Branch lists youth and arts resources, study pods, Wi-Fi, the Good As Gold book sculpture, and Sunday hours of 11 a.m.-6 p.m.
cards.source_title: Plaza Branch | Kansas City Public Library
cards.access_notes: Listed Sunday hours are 11 a.m.-6 p.m. The branch also lists free parking in its parking garage.
